title: Russian-Style Beet Skewers
description: A flavorful and colorful vegetarian dish inspired by Russian cuisine, featuring roasted beets and bell peppers on skewers.
instructions: Cut the beets, bell peppers, and onion into large chunks.
Thread the vegetables onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
In a small bowl, whisk together olive oil, salt, and black pepper.
Brush the mixture onto both sides of the vegetables.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Roast in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender.
Remove from the oven and let cool slightly.
Serve hot or at room temperature.
